verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents self-hosting its open-source core, Airbyte Core. Paths include a local quickstart, the open-source abctl CLI on any Docker host, and a guide for deploying to any Kubernetes cluster. A community user confirms they self-host it in production. An older report of a failed docker-compose install and a remark that some parts are non-free do not contradict that the core product can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: clarity on which security/enterprise features (SSO, RBAC) are excluded from the self-hosted open-source core, and more recent independent hands-on corroboration of installation reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This quickstart guides you through deploying a local instance of Airbyte Core, Airbyte's open source product.
abctl is Airbyte's open source command line tool to create and manage local instances of Airbyte running in Docker.
This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into any kubernetes cluster.
We use airbyte at my company, although we self-host it.
